title: Power-sum image of the hook-content linear transformation varphi
difficulty_reason: The retained author route does not reprove a known formula but evaluates a linear functional that is defined only on Schur functions: it expands the elementary symmetric function in power sums, tracks the epsilon/z coefficients through mu=(nu,1^m), and then applies varphi to the whole Cauchy identity and uses linear independence of the power sums to read off varphi(p_mu). The load-bearing steps are the coefficient bookkeeping with the sign eps_(nu,1^{m-i}) = (-1)^{n-ell} and the use of the Cauchy identity as an identity of functionals; neither is routine substitution, and the surrounding Lemma 3.1 supplies the expansion rather than the conclusion. Renaming t to v, paper length and the venue are not the difficulty basis.
